text: Patient continues on osimertinib with excellent partial response. Imaging shows significant tumor shrinkage. Patient feeling well with minimal side effects. ECOG performance status improved to 0. No respiratory symptoms. Mild grade 1 acneiform rash developing, managed with topical treatments. Labs stable. PLAN: Continue current therapy. Multidisciplinary re-evaluation in 4 weeks to discuss potential surgical resection given excellent response. If tumor continues to respond and becomes resectable, will consider surgical intervention followed by adjuvant therapy. Patient very pleased with treatment progress.
